decisions.reason: The black-finish drainage line is a design-led extension of the core range and should remain attractive for modern bathroom projects even if its online visibility was initially lighter.
The shower channel for seamless coverings fits directly with the firm's core drainage business and barrier-free design trend, and its dedicated page signals ongoing commitment.
The tileable floor drain with grating is closely tied to the established portfolio and serves installers and planners in a stable, core application area.
The stainless steel design drain grate is a low-risk, design-oriented complement to the main drainage systems and is unlikely to be removed quickly.

The pump-drain shower channel appears strategically relevant as a newer development in the drainage range, but pump-based products are more niche and technically sensitive, so its withdrawal risk is higher than for the standard lines.
